steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So, what do you think of my suggestion?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: After what you did to me on the first day? Won't let you manipulate me any more.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hey, I just greeted you and went back to sleep that day, didn't I? I don't recall you being this angry at me back then.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Or perhaps... something happened between us later that I forgot? Why don't you tell me all about it, hmm?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You forgot it?!
[Chief's mind is flooded with intimate memories from Day 1]

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Fine, forget it then. In any case, I won't let you—mmph!
Just as you finally manage to stand your ground and speak sternly, she leans closer to you along with the wisteria vines.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh, getting shy now, are we? Then let me just—

The vines coil around you once more, delving into your thoughts like a mind reader. Memories you tried so hard to forget come rushing back in an unstoppable flood. Meanwhile, the flower spirit's expression shifts through a kaleidoscope of emotions.
After savoring your memories, she lets out an impish laugh.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh my! Hehe... I had no idea we got so... adventurous...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I clearly underestimated you, sweetheart. You're quite capable indeed!
You shake off the wisteria vines clinging to you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: That was all a trap to lure in visitors and drain their life. Countless people are in the ICU because of you, and they're still in comas! Is this how you treat your guests? Trying to kill everyone?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I thought Yugu was the mastermind, and that you were all just fictional characters she created. I was so focused on stopping her—but now I see how wrong I was.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You two are in this together. This whole street is crawling with wicked spirits. If you don't let everyone go right now, I'll—

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: —What's "ICU"?
You roll your eyes for a moment.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh my, angry again? It must've been so rough for you. Let me put it this way—I'm not working with Yugu.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Think about it. When we first met, didn't I warn you to be careful and not wander off? If I really meant you harm, why would I have said something like that?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Since this is a street full of "wicked" spirits, couldn't that "Yingying" who gave you a hard time be someone else in disguise? Maybe you were so caught up thinking about me that another spirit played tricks on you?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You were the one bragging to me about how "lovely and so welcoming" they are, "keen to show their hospitality." Where is that hospitality you spoke of?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The ladies here and those vicious spirits out on the streets—every single one of them shows no mercy when it comes to exploiting their victims.
She averts her gaze and starts whistling, the guilt evident in her demeanor.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: It might not be anyone's fault at all. Considering your delicate little frame... Maybe you simply... exhausted yourself from having too much fun?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You were so cheerful when we first met, chatting non-stop about everything under the sun. And now, here you are, interrogating me...
You're about to rage!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Alright, alright! Nothing major has happened so far, right? If there's real trouble, I'll personally make sure you get home safely. Take it easy now, sweetheart.
After her consoling words, she playfully reaches out to pat your head. Even when you swat her hand away, she remains unfazed.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I know what that storyteller likes to write about. She has such a twisted sense of entertainment—enjoys watching people suffer, using all kinds of tricks to lure them into her tales just to pain them.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: With a writer like that, of course a fete in her story is full of troublemakers stirring up trouble. From what I've known, what she's putting you through now is actually quite lenient!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: But you see, I am the guardian of this street. Only I know what the true fete is like.
She gazes beyond the courtyard, as if listening to the lively clamor outside.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: The Spring Festival is meant to be the most joyous time of year. The locals have put so much effort into decorating the streets and inviting guests because they want everyone to have a good time and welcome the new year with the best of spirits. They would never harm you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Unlike Yugu, we love stories full of joy and peace, with happy endings where everyone gets to be with their loved ones.
She turns her gaze back to you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I can lend you a hand. All your friends trapped here by Yugu... I'll bring them back to their senses and make sure all of you get out safely.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: And I'll also help clear up any misunderstandings between you and the locals. Once you leave here, please remember us and remember how genuinely kind the people here are.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: If you're up for giving Yugu a taste of her own medicine, I know exactly where it will sting. We can give her a little payback~

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: But at this hour, the most fun part of the fete is about to start. Are you sure you don't want to stay and take a look? I promise you won't regret it.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It's just the wish-making ceremony, isn't it? Yugu already told me about it.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hah, that awful woman! How dare she spoil the surprise? Stealing my thunder!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Fine. I just wanted to see it for myself...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: It's been so long since we've had a fete... I really want to relive those memories. Can you keep me company, pretty please?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: In return, I'll help you set the record straight on the story Yugu messed up, and you'll get a free wish to start your new year right. How does that sound?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: The wisteria fairy cordially invites you to the fete. What do you say?
Is she trying to shift blame onto Yugu and wash her hands of the matter? You can't tell, and what's even more pressing is your lack of leverage against her.
The shackles prove futile against her—in this regard, she truly is like a fabricated illusion.

—Yet you sense something different about her compared to the spirits typically portrayed in Yugu's stories. Had that arrogant taleteller wielded her pen, this flower spirit would have taken on a different form... like that wild, chaotic dream from your first day—a domineering presence toying with her guest.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Like hell I would trust you!

steps.content: Either way, you'll need to spend some time investigating this new target.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Heh, I'll take that as a yes! Let's go!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh wait, before that, let me steal a little something from you.
Her voice is gentle yet playful. Before you can react, her hands softly rest on your shoulders, then glide to encircle your neck in a tender embrace.
Then, a warmth spreads across your neck as something soft brushes against it.

A tingling sensation surges with a slight sting, and you feel your strength rapidly drained from where she touches. Again, she's robbing you of your Qi, though "robbing" seems too harsh a word for such a gentle touch.
[Release the shackles]

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Ah!

The red beam pierces her body, only to scatter a cluster of flower petals. In the blink of an eye, she's perched back atop the vines, while your forceful attempt leaves you dizzy, forcing you to lean on her vines for stability.
The shackles still can't touch her, which only fuels your frustration. And sure enough, your visible annoyance only seems to delight her more.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I know you're capable, sweetheart, but there's no need to push yourself here. You're already exhausted—better not wear yourself out even more.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I promise I won't hurt you.
Before you can react, she glides behind you. Her hands settle gently on your shoulders as she speaks in her sweet, playful tone, her breath falling softly on your neck.
...Then, a warmth spreads across your neck as something soft brushes against it.

A tingling sensation surges with a slight sting, and you feel your strength rapidly drained from where she touches. Again, she's robbing you of your Qi, though "robbing" seems too harsh a word for such a gentle touch.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: That's the last time~

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh, don't be such a miser! I only borrowed a few seconds of your life. Besides, I need that energy to accompany you to the fete. Huff—
As she speaks, she lands gracefully on the ground. It's the first time you've seen her leave the wisteria tree.

Suddenly, the entire courtyard bursts into frenzied commotion. The "moms" let out twisted cries that transform into waves of malevolent energy surging toward you both. Startled, you instinctively release your shackles.
However, the flower spirit simply turns around, casual as can be, cups her hands around her mouth, and calls up to the building—

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Moms, I'm going on a date! Might be back a bit late tonight, just leave the door open!
The surging dark mist pauses for a moment, then slowly dissipates.
With bare feet, Yingying strides towards you. Upon meeting her gaze, you find her cheeks adorned with a flush of color, notably more energetic than before.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Let's go. The flower fairy shall be your fete companion. Volume III, here it unfolds!
